hero.title: A clearer starting point for your next crop decision.
hero.body: Explore a crop label predicted from seven soil and environmental measurements. The result is a model output, not a guarantee of local suitability.
hero.artLabel: Illustration of fields, hills, sun, and growing plants

how.title: From measurements to a model suggestion
how.body: The system uses the same seven named inputs that were used to train its current classifier.
how.step1Body: Provide the available nutrient and environmental values in the dataset's measurement scales.
how.step2Body: The saved Random Forest estimates a crop label from the values you provide.
how.step3Body: See the model's prediction, alternative scores when available, and any observed-range warnings.

form.title: Crop prediction
form.subtitle: This classifier runs independently of the unavailable Agricultural Field Assessment workflow.
form.measurementNote: N, P, and K refer to soil nutrient measurements in the dataset, not fertilizer application doses.
form.noMax: Use values in the same scales as the training data. There are no arbitrary upper limits.
form.required: Complete all seven required fields with valid numbers.
form.invalid: Enter a finite number in every field. All values except temperature must be non-negative.
form.sampleLoaded: A real feature row from the project dataset was loaded.

errors.validation: The API could not accept these values. Check the fields and try again.

results.title: Predicted crop label
results.caveat: This is a preliminary, data-driven model suggestion for the values entered—not a guarantee of suitability or success.
results.alternatives: Other model output labels (not field recommendations)
results.scoreNote: Scores describe the model's output distribution. They are not probabilities of crop survival, yield, or agricultural success.
results.warningsIntro: This valid input was still evaluated. These observed ranges are not universal safe or unsafe agricultural limits.
results.rangeWarning: Value {{value}} is outside the training-data range {{minimum}} to {{maximum}}.

catalog.title: The crops this model knows by label
catalog.subtitle: A simple reference for the crop names supported by the current benchmark model.
catalog.note: This list describes model labels, not a complete crop catalog or regional growing guide.
catalog.knowledgeOnlyLabel: Not supported by the ML model
catalog.unverifiedNotice: Agronomic details are unverified and are not recommendations.
catalog.unavailable: The crop catalog could not be loaded. No research-backed crop guidance is available.

profitability.title: Compare crop economics
profitability.optionalIntro: Uses only values you enter. It does not assess crop suitability.
profitability.missing: Enter these assumptions to calculate: {{fields}}. Blank costs are not treated as zero.
profitability.invalid: Use finite, non-negative values; field area must be greater than zero.
profitability.userEntered: Source: user-entered assumptions. No external prices or yield data were retrieved.
profitability.formulaNote: Revenue = area × yield per area unit × selling price. Net return = revenue − total costs; benefit-cost ratio = revenue ÷ total costs. Estimates are not guaranteed returns.

limitations.eyebrow: Read before relying on a result
limitations.title: A benchmark is not a field trial.
limitations.body: The dataset's provenance has not been independently verified. Strong benchmark scores do not establish performance on real farms. Region and season are not model inputs. The current 22 labels do not cover every crop relevant to Uttar Pradesh, including wheat and mustard.
limitations.guidance: Real crop choices also depend on local climate, soil testing, irrigation, season, and qualified agronomic guidance. Do not use this student model as the sole basis for a farming decision.

empty.title: Prediction result
empty.body: Enter the seven required model inputs to run the crop classifier.

workflow.title: Agricultural Field Assessment
workflow.unavailable: Workflow status could not be retrieved. No assessment has been submitted.
workflow.messageNotConnected: No workflow connection is configured. No field information has been submitted, and no assessment or clarification questions are available.
workflow.setupSummary: What is needed to connect this workflow?
workflow.setupDetails: Google's StreamAssist API can invoke registered Workflow Builder workflows and continue a session. However, required Manual Launch input variables cannot be supplied through the API. The workflow's trigger inputs, registered agent ID, backend identity and permission, and seven-field response format have not been verified. No request has been sent. Ask the workflow owner to confirm the trigger has no required inputs and that intake and clarification work from query text and session history. Backend configuration needs the project ID, app location and ID, and numeric workflow agent ID; credentials must use server-side Application Default Credentials.
